relationships.evidence_quote: Both inhibitors halted the development of bilateral hypersensitivity (Figures S5B and S5C), confirming that AKT/mTORC1 signaling is necessary to establish central sensitization and chronic pain.

relationships.subject: MD-1 diet
relationships.evidence_quote: MD-1 increased AMPK phosphorylation in uninjured mice

key_findings: Peripheral injury activates spinal AKT/mTORC1, shifting metabolism to biomass production, suppressing autophagy and depleting nutrients, driving pain chronicity.
A nutrient-enriched diet restored autophagy via SIRT1 and AMPK and prevented the transition to chronic pain in mice.
